text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I'm working in my office as usual<n>when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, uhhh... Excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Do you like chocolate, Big Brother?<n>Does it make
you happy when you<n>receive some?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Do you like chocolate, Big Sister?<n>Does it make you
happy when you<n>receive some?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I hear the word<n>"chocolate," I remember
that today's<n>Valentine's Day.
choice_data_list: I'd say it makes me happy, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-really?! Hehe, then I'll be right<n>back!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower runs off without another<n>word.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: A little later...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She builds a veritable mountain of<n>chocolates on my
desk.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I made a lot. Some milk chocolates,<n>some dark...
some with nuts, some<n>with strawberries...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pick whichever you want!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pick whichever you want!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You don't want to eat a flavor<n>you don't like,
right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why I made so many... Your<n>favorite kind
has to be in there<n>somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Rice Shower put a lot of<n>effort into
making sure I had a good<n>Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh... what's wrong? Did I not make<n>your favorite?
choice_data_list: Can I take all of them?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Can you even eat all of them?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Are you... really sure?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She seems worried about the taste. I<n>should ease
her concerns...
choice_data_list: If I can't do it, will you help me finish them?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sure!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heehee... I can eat a ton. Let me<n>know right away
when you've had<n>too much!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I made them!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I eat my first Valentine's Day<n>chocolate while Rice
Shower intensely<n>watches me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She seems worried about the taste. I<n>should ease
her concerns...
choice_data_list: I want to accept all of your feelings, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You don't have to...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... if these chocolates represent<n>my feelings,
then I should have made<n>more.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This isn't nearly enough to show<n>how much you
mean to me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This isn't nearly enough to show<n>how much you
mean to me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, I spend a sweet Valentine's<n>Day with Rice
Shower.
